false_positive_fix_detail: 3 live false-positives in AccountMenu (shell.jsx buttons «Профиль»/«Мои настройки»/«Сменить организацию», originally ~917/930/978) came from a reason living in a sibling <span> AFTER the button's closing tag — the gate only judges the opening tag block, so REASON_RE never sees it. Fixed on the component side: added id= to each reason <span> and aria-describedby= on the corresponding <button>, matching the established pattern already used elsewhere in the same file (topbar «+ Исполнитель» / «Экспорт прав» stubs, shell.jsx lines 631-663). Chose component-side over gate-side because (1) these buttons were NOT actually fully accessible before — a screen reader had no programmatic link from the disabled control to its reason, only sighted-user visual adjacency — so this is a genuine a11y fix, not just linter appeasement; (2) widening the gate to recognize 'any visible text after the tag close' would weaken true-positive detection (a genuinely fake button could dodge the gate by having unrelated visible text somewhere later in the render).
tag_close_hardening: has_tag_close() had a two-sided blind spot: a bare '>' inside a JSX expression (e.g. `{x > 5}`) survived the old `=>`/`>=` two-char-token stripping and was mistaken for the tag-closing '>'. This caused (a) false positives on honest multi-line controls whose reason marker landed after the expression line (block judged prematurely, before the reason was folded in) and (b) false negatives on genuine fake buttons whose expression preceded the inert marker (premature judgment on an incomplete fragment found nothing, reset tracking, then silently dropped the rest of the real tag since a continuation line that doesn't itself start `<Tag` is ignored outside block-tracking). Fixed by adding strip_brace_exprs() — a brace-depth-tracked pass that erases every `{...}` JSX-expression span (including nested braces, e.g. `{(e) => e.preventDefault()}`) from a scratch copy of the text BEFORE searching for the real closing '>'. The existing `=>`/`>=` stripping is kept as a defensive layer on the depth-0 residue. Both directions verified empirically: reverting to the naive has_tag_close reproduces the false-positive (a synthetic honest control gets wrongly flagged) and the false-negative (a synthetic fake button with the same shape is silently dropped, 0 findings) — the new self-test cases catch both when run against the pre-fix implementation (self-test exits 2).
self_test_strengthening_detail: N-3 (T-0699 review): the two 'honest' asserts (ЧестнаяДискрайб/ЧестнаяТайтл) only checked that the control's own LABEL text never appears in a finding. Empirically confirmed this is cross-mode-weak: reverting classify_added_lines to the pre-T-0699 line-local heuristic on the exact same fixture set produces 8 findings instead of 3 (2 spurious findings per honest multi-line control, from the bare aria-disabled/onClick attribute lines judged standalone) — but NONE of those spurious findings contain the label text (it lives on a separate line), so the old assert kept passing straight through the regression. Replaced with per-control ISOLATED classification (each honest control run through classify_added_lines alone) asserting the output is completely EMPTY — this fails loudly (and prints the bogus finding) on any fragment-level regression, confirmed to catch the line-local reversion where the label-substring check did not.
bites_evidence: 1) Real diff-based run: `bash ci/checks/ux/ux-g7-no-fake-buttons.sh --required` against dev...HEAD (post-commit, non-empty diff touching the 3 AccountMenu buttons) reports '0 newly-added fake-button finding(s)', exit 0. 2) Whole-file synthetic-add scan of shell.jsx (mirrors the T-0699 reviewer's whole-tree-audit method: treat every line as '+') now yields 0 findings, down from the reviewer's documented 3 (N-2, T-0699.review.md). 3) `--self-test` passes end-to-end (17 assertions) including 4 new T-0730 cases. 4) Reverting has_tag_close() to the pre-fix (non-brace-aware) implementation makes the new self-test FAIL at 'T-0730: fake button (aria-disabled, then {x > 5}, no reason) still flagged' (exit 2) — proves (б) bites. 5) Reverting classify_added_lines() to a pure line-local heuristic reproduces the old label-substring check silently PASSING (confirmed via isolated harness run) while the new isolated-emptiness check correctly FAILS on the same input — proves (в) bites and the old asserts were genuinely tautological as N-3 claimed.
